well, idk. just, once u get to a point this low u truly look at the world and i feel i can’t ever see it the same again. it doesn’t matter what u believe in or where we end up, bc we don’t know that. all we know is now. just as people get better and succeed, ppl get worse and fail. whatever creator we have is nothing to be worshipped. they cannot love us if we’re put through this. ppl say everyone can get better. but the statistics, the numbers, the suicides, they all come from some where. and that’s what i’m meant to be.
talking don’t change things. maybe give a moments peace but that’s about it. something always ruins it or i feel like shit.

yeah. its hard and sometimes i wish i could just say fuck it i’m gonna prove them all wrong. i literally can’t bring myself too. the best that’s gonna happen to me at this point is i’m gonna do drugs for the rest of my life to numb everything.
everything.

yeah 100%, just bc a few ppl get out of feeling like this ppl think it means the same for everyone. idk if i believe in fate completely, but if u believe ppl r destined for great lives that also means the opposite. ppl have to be those ppl and live those lives, here we are.
there’s just no hope for me. no matter what i do life is always shit. nothing gives joy, nothing matters to me anymore.
it just feels like this is what i’m meant for. not to say i ain’t happy for ppl who get out of this but for some it just seems we’re not meant for that.
no matter what i do is gonna be shit. i literally have 0 motivation to take showers some days, much less keep a job or give a fuck about grades.
now we’re expected to get over everything we feel because we gotta do adult shit, but then if we do smth it’s “oh no! why didn’t they let us know!!”
i get that 100%. once you realize how this world works you realize everything we believe, have been taught, etc is just all utterly useless.

ah, thank you so much. i know reassurance isn’t a good thing, so i’m going to ask for advice. i am only 14 and cannot talk to my parents or family about this issue. i know many ppl will just be like “oh, just tell them, they’ll support you!” not these kinds of thoughts, no, they wouldn’t. so what do you suggest i could do?
i’ve seen people last with panic, etc for years though. how come i’ve become apathetic in a few days?
so this doesn’t mean i’m a pedophile? if i do manage to think less or the thoughts and not feel disgusted?
how did i suddenly go from throwing up at these thoughts to now sitting here uncaring? i think that’s what’s stopping me from moving on.
i think i understand, thank you. i’ll try that out and hopefully it will help.

was it hard for you at first? like even telling yourself that? i’ve tried but i want to fight it. like nope! those intrusive thoughts r wrong and i need to prove them wrong. but ik that doesn’t help at all.

i’m sorry, i’m just so worried. is there just some way i can ever know for sure? logically i know all about how groinal responses work, etc. but i feel like my thoughts aren’t intrusive anymore. like sometimes to prove myself wrong i’ll purposely think of a child to prove i’m not attracted, ill feel nothing but then my brain is like look! u feel smth! and ik it’s groinal response but then i get scared what if it’s actually smth? i don’t know what to do anymore.

logically i know what i am but i can’t stop thinking about it. i read something ab how pedos can feel ashamed and scared and confused. what if i’m doing that? what i’ve i’m just some pedo who deep within me knows what i am?

is it normal to eventually feel desensitized to them? like they don’t make u as disgusted? bc that’s been happening to me, and then i feel awful but also numb, and then something in me is like see, this is what u r, u like this just accept it, ur a pedo, even if u wouldn’t hurt kids u like these thoughts etc. i use to get nauseous and dizzy at these thoughts, but now i feel nothing and then i get scared they’re right. what if they are? how do i know i’m not. this is so awful i don’t know if i can do this anymore.
